description: Defines the class AnonymousTokensRsaBssaClient for generating and processing RSA blind signatures within the anonymous_tokens namespace. It includes methods for creating signature requests, processing responses, and verifying tokens, along with internal data structures and dependencies.

classes.name: AnonymousTokensRsaBssaClient
classes.description: A class for generating RSA blind signatures, creating signing requests, processing responses, and verifying tokens. Not thread-safe, non-copyable.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the client with a specified public key.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Generates a signature request with blinded messages.

methods.name: ProcessResponse
methods.description: Processes server response to obtain unblinded tokens.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies the validity of an anonymous token.
